outline: ‘Analysis and decision making using data’ course deals with various analysis and decision-making techniques using data. Recent years have seen an explosion of the amount of data available to everyone, and making sense of that data has become an operational imperative. The tools of statistics are one of the ways we can make sense of the data and use it to make more effective decisions. Thus, in this course we will introduce the concepts of descriptive and inferential statistics, several efficient prediction techniques such as regression analysis, and their use in decision making.
